feature_manifest.limitation: Exploratory discovery-only feature table; all source structures were previously observed. Neutral correctness is scored reference-oracle access, separately declared from raw query features. Ownership sources are excluded because they have no distinct naming counterpart.

codellama34b.limitation: Exploratory nested grouped cross-validation on previously consumed discovery data, not M5 confirmation or a frozen unfamiliar-program forecast. No mechanism C, confidence or internal measurement feature is fitted. Repeated fold seeds reuse the same data and are not independent replications. Bootstrap intervals condition on the saved OOF predictions and do not rerun feature collection, model fitting or hyperparameter selection. Raw neutral behavior uses one distinct extra query without its oracle correctness; the scored tier additionally requires the neutral reference oracle. Target response properties and correctness never enter features.
